Home.eyebrow: Office of the Registrar General of Marriages
Home.title: Marriage registration, made clearer.
Home.lede: The modern citizen gateway for West Bengal’s marriage registration services. Choose the Act, understand the process, and reach the right Marriage Officer.
Home.finderNote: Official guidance, timelines, and required documents.
Home.ledgerHeading: We register marriages. We add value to marriages.
Home.ledgerBody: A secure digital record supports citizens through legal separation, citizenship, inheritance, and other legal and social matters.

acts.title: Find your requirements
acts.body: Answer a few questions to see the documents, fees, and legal steps that apply to you.
acts.label: Open Act finder

status.title: Check an application
status.body: See where your registration stands using your application number and date of birth.

offices.label: Find an office

Home.trustBody: Every requirement links back to an official act, notice, or service source. We show when it was last checked so you can make decisions with the full context.
Home.trustPointBody: Plain-language summaries never replace the law. They help you reach it.

Status.title: Check where your application stands.
Status.lede: Enter your application number and the date of birth of either applicant. You do not need to sign in.

Fees.title: Know the cost before you apply.
Fees.lede: Fees depend on the Act you apply under. Confirm the current figure with your Marriage Officer before paying.
